name: Craftsman 172.34120
blurb: Oregon prints one chain under 172.34120: 18″ bar, 3/8″ low profile, .050″ gauge, 63 drive links (S63).
intro: Oregon's saw-chain selection guide prints Craftsman 172.34120 on its own line with one chain: S63, 18″ bar, 63 drive links, .050″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. 63 links is the count Oregon prints. It is not the 62-link loop on many other 18″ low-profile bars. The guide does not print a file size.

bars.note: Oregon prints S63 directly under Craftsman 172.34120: 18″ bar, 63 drive links, .050″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. No file size is printed.

sources.title: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide: model line printed with saw-chain code, bar length, drive links, gauge and pitch

sources_note: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide (https://apps.oregonproducts.com/pdfs/TSC-Chain-Fit-Guide.pdf), read 7 Nov 2026. The guide does not print a file size on these rows.
